_readme: 5 index underlyings -- the single source of truth for indices across this app (Scanner, GapFill curated list, symbol search). Plain shape only: name/symbol/exchange/type. F&O-specific fields (expiryTypes, expiryDayRule, etc.) live separately in derivatives-config.json, keyed by 'name', so this file stays lean and usable by any consumer regardless of whether it cares about derivatives tracking. FINNIFTY's spot symbol (NSE:CNXFINANCE-INDEX) is confirmed correct and internally consistent with backend/src/server.js's own INDEX_ROOT_TO_SYMBOL mapping -- but live fetchOptionChain calls against it have been observed erroring 'Please provide a valid symbol' in real terminal logs. This is a known, unresolved, separate issue -- not a wrong symbol in this file. Flagged for investigation, not silently worked around.
